paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: : Accuracy and reasoning chain length (# L) of on GSM8k dataset when trained with c{1,3,5,7} and tested with extra c{2,4,6} (under gray bars).

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between the compression factor and two variables: accuracy and the logarithm of the number of reasoning chain lengths. The x-axis is labeled "Compression Factor (c)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 7, and tick labels at every integer value. The left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 40, and tick labels at intervals of 10, while the right y-axis is labeled "log(#L)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1.5 to 3.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Two lines are plotted: a purple line representing accuracy, which starts at around 44% at a compression factor of 1, decreases to around 30% at a compression factor of 2, increases to approximately 34% at a compression factor of 3, then gradually decreases to around 20% at a compression factor of 6 before rising to about 23% at a compression factor of 7, and a golden line representing log(#L), which begins at around 3.1 at a compression factor of 1, steadily decreases to approximately 1.5 at a compression factor of 7, with a notable drop between compression factors 1 and 2, and continues to decline with a gentler slope thereafter.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between the compression factor and two variables: accuracy percentage and the logarithm of the number of reasoning chain lengths, denoted as log(#L). The x-axis represents the compression factor (c), with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, marked at integer values. The left y-axis represents accuracy percentage, also on a linear scale, spanning from 10% to 40% with tick labels at intervals of 10%. The right y-axis represents log(#L), on a linear scale, ranging from 1.5 to 3.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Two lines are plotted: the purple line, representing accuracy percentage, starts at approximately 44% when the compression factor is 1, decreases to around 30% at a compression factor of 2, peaks at about 34% at a compression factor of 3, then gradually declines to 20% at a compression factor of 6 before rising to around 24% at a compression factor of 7; the golden line, representing log(#L), begins at roughly 3.1 when the compression factor is 1, steadily decreases to approximately 1.5 at a compression factor of 7, with data points at compression factors of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7.
